name: NINJA
desc:
There is an ancient tale, passed down through the ages, of war, violence, peace, and the awakening of sentience, It is said that the land of ninja.. Of paradise, holds the chronicles of the beginning and the diaries of the endings, as you travel through the realms of paradise, may your journey be one of discovery and transformation.

In this world, there are beings far more powerful than you, some worshipped as false gods, others defined as the very progenitors of the land, but it is up to you to forge a new legacy, to create a fresh lineage and a story that will resonate throughout time.

Ninja is a land ever-changing, ever-expanding, vital and full of untold potential, spread your wings and soar into its vastness and may the gods of tao bless you on your journey, guiding your steps as you write your own chapter in the ongoing saga of this world
